setting: Norsk filminnspilling på location — kaos ved gryning som overvinnes til kontroll i gyllen time
mode: 90s behovsdrevet merkevarefilm — kaos→helvete→mestring. Must-have, ikke nice-to-have. Empati for krevende produksjon, forløsning = oversikt/kontroll/mestring. Ikke selg — vis at bransjen har dette behovet.

character.lock: kvinnelig produsent / 1. regiassistent, 30-år, praktisk feltjakke, headset rundt halsen

vo.tone: empatisk, alvorlig i kaoset → rolig og sikker i mestringen

shots.motion: she scrolls a phone flooded with messages, other crew glance at their phones confused, tense subtle handheld
shots.prompt: before dawn on a film location, a stressed 1st AD stares at a phone screen flooded with conflicting group-chat messages, two other crew nearby also staring at phones looking confused, scattered papers, no clear plan, cold blue pre-dawn light with a faint purple haze, documentary realism, tense

shots.motion: crew members look around lost, checking phones, someone shrugs, disoriented handheld
shots.prompt: a confused film crew standing around in the wrong spot at a location at dawn, checking phones and looking lost, equipment cases half-unloaded and abandoned, nobody knowing where to be, overcast cold light, faint purple in the shadows, documentary

shots.motion: a camera operator stands idle waiting, gaffers still rigging in the background, a frustrated gesture, tense
shots.prompt: tension on a film set — a camera operator stands idle by the camera waiting while gaffers are still rigging lights in the background, a crew member gestures in frustration, disorganized, everyone waiting on someone else, cold morning light, subtle purple haze

shots.motion: she gestures in frustration on the phone at the locked gate, crew waiting behind, tense handheld
shots.prompt: a stressed film producer on the phone at a locked gate of a closed location, gesturing in frustration, access denied, a crew van and idle crew waiting behind her, overcast grey morning, a faint purple cast, tense, documentary

shots.motion: crew stand around checking watches and phones, the light fading, a producer rubs her temples, weary
shots.prompt: a film crew standing around idle on set as the light fades, checking watches and phones, time and money visibly slipping away, a producer with her hand to her forehead, exhausted frustrated faces, dusk, muted purple-grey light, documentary

shots.motion: a heavy stillness, she sits exhausted, crew packing up in silence behind, defeated
shots.prompt: a defeated film crew at the end of a bad shoot day — the producer sits exhausted and disappointed, crew packing up in silence behind her, missed shots, heavy failure, low grey dusk light with a cold purple tone, emotional, documentary

shots.motion: she takes a breath and looks down at the tablet, a moment of calm resolve; the tablet screen stays flat and still, minimal motion
shots.prompt: a turning point — the producer takes a breath and opens a tablet held in her hands, calm and resolve returning amid the set, warm soft light beginning to break the cold; plain green tablet screen, over-the-shoulder

shots.motion: she glances from the tablet up to the organized crew and back; the tablet screen stays flat and still, minimal motion
shots.prompt: the producer between setups checking the tablet shot list, an organized crew and camera working smoothly behind her, calm control; plain green tablet screen, over-the-shoulder, warm light, NO LED panels

shots.motion: crew clap and embrace, tired joyful movement, golden hour, lively handheld
shots.prompt: a film crew celebrating a good wrap in golden hour — claps, hugs, tired satisfied joy, a 'that's a wrap' feeling of goals met on time, warm backlight, real crew, emotional, documentary, NO LED panels

vo_lines.en: Every production begins with a plan.
vo_lines.no: Hver produksjon begynner med en plan.

vo_lines.en: And before sunrise, it's already on your shoulders.
vo_lines.no: Og før soloppgang hviler alt på deg.

vo_lines.en: But the call sheet is buried in a group chat.
vo_lines.no: Men call sheet-en er begravd i en gruppechat.

vo_lines.en: Half the crew is in the wrong place.
vo_lines.no: Halve crewet er på feil sted.

vo_lines.en: Camera waits on lighting. No one knows the order.
vo_lines.no: Kamera venter på lys. Ingen vet rekkefølgen.

vo_lines.en: Every idle minute burns the budget.
The shot is gone. The day's goals slip away.
vo_lines.no: Taket er tapt. Dagens mål glipper.

vo_lines.en: It was never meant to be this hard.
vo_lines.no: Det var aldri meningen at det skulle være så vanskelig.

vo_lines.en: Casting, crew, call sheets — one place, one truth.
vo_lines.no: Casting, crew, call sheets — ett sted, én sannhet.

vo_lines.en: The whole shoot, live in your hands.
vo_lines.no: Hele innspillingen, live i hendene dine.

vo_lines.en: Roll, cut — every take accounted for.
vo_lines.no: Roll, cut — hvert take gjort rede for.

vo_lines.en: You catch the light. You make the shot.
vo_lines.no: Du fanger lyset. Du får taket.

vo_lines.en: In control. On top of it all.
vo_lines.no: I kontroll. Med grep om alt.

vo_lines.en: That's a wrap — on schedule, and earned.
vo_lines.no: That's a wrap — i rute, og fortjent.

vo_lines.en: The Role Room. What demanding productions run on.
vo_lines.no: The Role Room. Det krevende produksjoner drives på.
